Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees (roughly 25% of its workforce) to cut costs and invest in AI. The offer is available to staff at the vice-president level and below in select teams across the U.S., Canada, India, and Britain, while groups like data centers, sales, and marketing are excluded.
